title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for FY2018/2019
what_it_is: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for FY2018/2019

sections.label: Supplementary Estimates for autonomous universities
sections.summary: The Supplementary Estimates provide $300 million to the Ministry mainly for higher than expected endowment matching grants to autonomous universities.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head K be reduced by $100 in respect of Code 3000.” Mr Chairman, I declare my interest as a faculty member in an autonomous university (AU).

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The Supplementary Estimates provide $300 million to the Ministry mainly to meet higher than expected endowment matching grants to the AUs.

sections.label: NTU and NUS donation amounts
sections.summary: NTU's average donations from 2015 to 2018 were about $35 million a year, while NUS ranged from $156 million to $276 million.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For example, in 2011 the Lee Foundation gave $150 million to fund the Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine at Nanyang Technological University (NTU).

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In contrast, from 2015 to 2018, NTU’s average donations were only about $35 million a year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For the four years from 2015 to 2018, NTU’s donations ranged from $16 million to $53 million each year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For the National University of Singapore (NUS), the range was $156 million to $276 million.

sections.label: Singapore Universities Trust matching grants
sections.summary: MOE's matching grants are supplemented by payouts from the $2 billion Singapore Universities Trust, set up to support the Enhanced Endowment Funding Model.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Chairman, the Member is right that in providing matching grants for donations raised by our AUs, there can be large one-time payments from MOE to the AUs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: That is why MOE's matching grants are supplemented by payouts by the Singapore Universities Trust (SUT).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The SUT is a $2 billion trust fund that has been set up by the Government for the purpose of supporting the Enhanced Endowment Funding Model.
